name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write a standalone OpenQAS
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write a standalone OpenQASM 3 program preparing an 6-qubit GHZ state with measurement, plus Python code that loads it with qiskit.qasm3 and samples 1000 shots. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
